01 • Strategic Foundation
Sector-Agnostic Analytical Velocity & Clarity
Core Mission
Democratizing Direction
Renalytica exists to eliminate statistical clutter. We engineer high-velocity data platforms that translate complex mathematical models into immediate, boardroom-ready strategic direction across agriculture, commerce, and macroeconomics.
Target Audience
Executive Decision-Makers
Our primary consumers are C-suite executives, investment strategists, research analysts, and institutional operators who require instant, uncompromised signal over noise without deciphering raw spreadsheet friction.
Brand Archetype
The Precision Vanguard
Authoritative, razor-sharp, mathematical, and forward-looking. Renalytica communicates with the restraint and weight of an institutional research terminal paired with the fluid agility of modern SaaS software.

02 • Brandmark Construction
The Geometry of Analytical Breakthrough
1. The Monogram 'R' Framework
Slate Grey Structural Foundation (#586472)
The architectural uppercase 'R' forms the solid anchor, conveying institutional durability, computational reliability, and empirical authority.
2. The Ascending Growth Trajectory
Momentum Orange 3-Node Trendline (#FF8000)
A dynamic vector line connecting sequential statistical data nodes, culminating in an upward arrowhead that penetrates the counter of the 'R' at a forward 45° angle.
3. The Quantitative Bar Foundation
3 Ascending Energy Columns
Three stepped vertical bars nested within the lower-left leg, symbolizing ground-truth metrics, incremental discovery, and compounding yield.

04 • Brand Governance
Clear Space & Minimum Scale Constraints
Clear Space Protection Zone
The 'X' Exclusion Perimeter
To preserve visual prominence and brand integrity, the brandmark must always be surrounded by an isolation boundary equal to 'X' (the exact height of the three bar chart columns).
No headline, boundary rule, margin border, or secondary icon may encroach upon this clear zone.
Reproduction Scale
Minimum Size Thresholds
To ensure legibility across dense data displays and high-resolution print media, strictly observe minimum dimension boundaries:
DIGITAL SCREENS
32px (Emblem)
120px (Lockup)
PRINT MEDIA
10 mm (Emblem)
35 mm (Lockup)
For micro-favicons (< 24px), use the standalone simplified vector monogram without tagline.

06 • Typography System
Executive Typography Hierarchy
Primary Brand Font
Montserrat
Montserrat is a geometric sans-serif typeface inspired by early 20th-century urban signage. Its clean, mathematically proportioned letterforms provide maximum clarity in high-density analytical dashboards and commanding presence in boardroom presentations.

abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789

11 • Governance & Compliance
Brandmark Misuse & Prohibitions
×
Do Not Distort or Stretch
Never scale the logo non-proportionally. Maintain exact 1:1 aspect ratio across all media.
×
Do Not Alter Colors
Never replace Slate Grey or Momentum Orange with unapproved arbitrary gradients or hues.
×
Do Not Add Drop Shadows
Do not apply harsh drop shadows, outer glows, 3D bevels, or heavy outlines to the logo marks.
×
Do Not Rotate Elements
The 'R' monogram and tagline must remain strictly horizontal. Do not rotate at arbitrary angles.
×
Do Not Place on Busy Backdrops
Never place the brandmark on complex, low-contrast photographic or textured backgrounds.
×
Do Not Re-typeset Wordmark
Always use the official vector asset. Never attempt to manually re-type the wordmark using substitute fonts.
